authority_control.safety_rule: no accepted exact-action authority and required evidence, no provider entry
authority_control.post_entry_uncertainty: INDETERMINATE; refuse blind replay pending authenticated reconciliation

evidence_semantics.posture_evidence: Describes observed configuration or coverage only; it is not action admission.
evidence_semantics.admission_evidence: Binds a Gate decision to one exact action and admitted attempt; it is not provider outcome or effect proof.
evidence_semantics.outcome_evidence: Requires separate authenticated provider evidence; it does not by itself prove the intended real-world effect.
evidence_semantics.effect_evidence: Requires a named effect predicate and admissible observation beyond admission and provider outcome.
